name: Recycling
overview: Scripture reveals that God entrusted mankind with the care and stewardship of the earth, as seen in Genesis 2:15 where Adam is placed in Eden to tend and keep the garden. The earth belongs to the LORD and all that is within it (Psalms 24:1), underscoring our responsibility to manage His creation wisely. The command to gather leftovers so that nothing is lost (John 6:12) reflects a principle of careful resource use and respect for what God provides. Additionally, the land must not be polluted or defiled (Numbers 35:33), emphasizing the importance of preserving the purity and productivity of the environment God has given us.
